question: By what name are the flat membrane-enclosed sacs present in the Golgi apparatus known?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cisternae**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Cisternae** are the flat, membrane-enclosed sacs that are a characteristic feature of the Golgi apparatus.
